_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. One should-trigger case per ad direction (product hero, offer, testimonial, before/after, comparison, feature callout, lifestyle) plus a single-vs-set case, and negatives that must route elsewhere: generating-product-photos (a plain product photo with no ad message), generating-ad-videos (video ads), and generating-images (general artwork / a non-product poster).
